text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out at the shopping district with 
Dream Journey to buy equipment for 
training—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That inn was...
choice_data_list: Is something catching your interest?
Is something catching your interest?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a hot spring trip voucher for 
the grand prize, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's an inn I've had my eye on for a 
while, thinking it would be great to take 
my family to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I remembered that I 
have just enough raffle tickets from 
shopping earlier for one draw.
choice_data_list: Then wanna try this raffle?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my—...Are you sure? This was earned 
from your shopping, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
Because it was shopping necessary for our 
"journey."

Because it was a purchase we needed for 
our "journey."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I'll take you up on that 
offer and give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, it would be nice to win 
something, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey slowly turns the handle of 
the lottery machine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And to everyone's surprise—
choice_data_list: We did it!!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My, oh my...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I never imagined it would 
actually hit the mark."
choice_data_list:
Looks like your good everyday karma paid 
off.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh... haha...! You say the most amusing 
things, Trainer—
choice_data_list:
(W-Was there anything funny about 
that...?)

(W-Was there anything funny about 
that...?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What a remarkably forgiving god that must 
beâ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Now then, regarding this ticket.
choice_data_list: When are you going with your family?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I gave it a little thought, would it be 
all right if I left this with you, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Huh? Why—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This trip is indeed very appealing, but... 
we are currently in the middle of our own 
"journey."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it would be best to head over 
once we'd wrapped things up here."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, if I keep it, I might end up 
spending it on my family without 
thinking—"
choice_data_list: ...If that's the case, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ……Please do your best. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Oh my...! This is magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I certainly didn't expect to win 
the hot springs trip voucher, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, these are more than satisfactory 
results. This Hamburg steak is of 
exceptionally fine quality..."
choice_data_list: Wanna eat with Orfevre?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fumu...――

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Since we have this opportunity—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting. Now then, shall we 
eat?
choice_data_list: Oooh...! Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Lined up on the table are mouthwatering 
dishes Dream Journey cooked by borrowing 
the cafeteria's kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the prize hamburg steak as the main 
dish, along with potato salad, minestrone, 
an omelet, and marinated fish—they all 
look delicious...!
choice_data_list:
Still, are you really sure it's okay for 
me to eat with you?

Still, are you really sure it's okay for 
me to eat with you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These dishes were made by Dream Journey 
"while she was at it," after deciding to 
eat hamburg steak together with me—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a token of my gratitude for 
everything you do for me.
choice_data_list: ...Thanks for making so much for me!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No matter how good the ingredients, 
a hamburger steak on its own is a bit 
lacking, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As fellow companions on this "journey," 
let us share a meal together today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dream Journey and I savored the 
prize Salisbury steak together, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, the warmth dwelling within the 
meal Dream Journey had cooked for me felt 
somehow more profoundly memorable—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Winning was a stroke of good fortune, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We received far more than I had expected. 
It looks like it won't be easy to use it 
all up.
choice_data_list: Want to try sharing some with someone?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like a good idea. Shall we do 
that, then?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Well, since we're here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, max heat right here!! Lock all 
that flavor in at once!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! The thrill of teetering right 
on the edge of burning the carrots...! I 
can't get enough of it...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Here, Orfe. It's fully cooked, so eat up. 
The seasoning is just right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I'm grilling some meat for you right now, 
Trainer. Please wait just a little longer, 
okay?"
choice_data_list: Thank you...! I'll also give Journey's—
Thank you...! I'll also give Journey's—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't mind me. Go ahead and 
enjoy yourself with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing this because I want to. 
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the prize carrots were put to 
good use during our quality time 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Well... that's about expected.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Still, just a single carrot is oddly 
difficult to find a use for.
choice_data_list: True...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I'll do this for the first time 
in a while.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be all right if I held 
onto these carrots for you?
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Look forward to 
tomorrow, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, at the meeting—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Shall we hold our meeting while eating 
this today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Dream Journey said that, what she lined 
up on the table were tiny cupcakes.
choice_data_list: (This scent... could it be—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—As you guessed, it's a cake made using 
yesterday's carrots.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It's nothing fancy, but please, enjoy.
choice_data_list:
Thanks, that looks absolutely 
delicious...!
Thank you, this looks so delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I used to make this for Orfe all the 
time, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had many chances lately, so it 
felt a little nostalgic.
choice_data_list: ...It's a taste filled with memories, huh.

...It's a taste filled with memories, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Young Orfe
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Delicious—

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Eat up. I'll make more for you anytime.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...They're precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The carrot cake Dream Journey made had 
a sweet, gentle taste that felt somewhat 
comforting and soothing—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was able to catch a glimpse of the deep 
affection she holds for her little 
sister...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Good grief...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"After Trainer-san went out of their way 
to give me this opportunity, to think it 
ended with this result..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Relying on luck really is so 
unpredictable—
choice_data_list:
(Huh... Are they more bothered about it 
than I thought?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please take this, Trainer. It's the least 
I can do to make it up to you.
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we head home early?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey seemed far more disappointed 
about missing out than I'd expected...
